upstream.note: Structured incident metadata + factual summaries; every row deep-links the original.

incidents.title: liverpool.ac.uk: Claimed by Scarlettgroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: Scarlettgroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Scarlettgroup group listed liverpool.ac.uk on its leak site. The organisation has not confirmed an attack, so treat this as a claim. United Kingdom.

incidents.title: Septeo IT Solutions: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Intrusion into an internal CRM platform detected on November 22 resulted in theft of contact records, billing information and support-ticket details. The company filed a complaint. France.

incidents.title: Ochsner Sport: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Hackers accessed customer data including names, addresses, invoices and payment methods. Passwords and account data were untouched and a criminal complaint was filed. Dietikon, Switzerland.

incidents.title: Proliance Surgeons: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Class-action investigation announced regarding breach discovered September 2 and announced November 6. Exposed data includes names, DOB, medical record numbers and SSNs for some. Seattle, United States.

incidents.title: Mediadu: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Mediadu reported unauthorized access affecting the Comic C'MoA partner content delivery and sales service. Japan.

incidents.title: Kyoei Steel: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Kyoei Steel reported unauthorized access to the internal network and shared file server of its US subsidiary, Vinton Steel LLC. Japan.

incidents.title: Satsudora: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Satsudora reported a personal-data leak of 220,000 records caused by a contractor's misconfiguration. Japan.

incidents.title: Valley Family Health Care: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Valley Family Health Care, Inc. reported a data breach to the California Attorney General with names exposed. Notification letters were sent via IDX to affected individuals. Los Angeles, United States.

incidents.title: Telecare Health: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Telecare Health notified 19,922 Washington residents of a data breach where names were exposed. Letters were sent via IDX to inform affected individuals. Seattle, United States.

incidents.title: Phreesia: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Phreesia, Inc. disclosed a vendor breach linked to the Salesloft Drift supply-chain incident, affecting 100,000 people with SSNs and medical data exposed. Letters were sent via Kroll. Denver, United States.

incidents.title: Honigman LLP: Claimed by SilentRansomGroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: SilentRansomGroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. SilentRansomGroup claims data theft from the US law firm. The listing appeared on the group's leak site on November 25. United States.

incidents.title: Camsons Pty: Claimed on a leak site, not confirmed
incidents.description: Claimed on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Spacebears ransomware group listed Camsons Pty Ltd, a transport and logistics company, on its data leak site. Sydney, Australia.

incidents.title: Markt Buttenheim: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. The German municipality of Markt Buttenheim reported an IT security incident that left the town hall's IT infrastructure largely unavailable. The town published a notice about the outage. Germany.

incidents.title: Vincci Hotels: Claimed by Black X, not confirmed
incidents.description: Black X claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Black X claimed Spanish hotel group Vincci Hotels as a victim on its leak site. The claim was not confirmed by the company. Spain.

incidents.title: sunnybrook.ca: Claimed by Scarlettgroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: Scarlettgroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Scarlettgroup group listed sunnybrook.ca on its leak site. The organisation has not confirmed an attack, so treat this as a claim. Canada.

incidents.title: City of El Cajon: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 24 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. A suspected cyberattack on the City of El Cajon may have exposed police personnel information along with medical and financial records. The breach is under investigation and not confirmed. El Cajon, United States.

incidents.title: MiTAC Digital Technology: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 24 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Taiwanese technology company MiTAC Digital Technology reported that parts of its IT systems were affected by an external cyberattack. The company said there was no initial material operational or financial impact. Taoyuan, Taiwan.

incidents.title: Elmet Group: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Elmet Group Co. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on 2026-11-24 that discusses a cybersecurity incident. Read the filing for scope and impact. Portland, United States.

incidents.title: Rakuten Securities: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Rakuten Securities revealed that unauthorised access led to the leak of roughly 4.41 million records, including customer asset balance information. No fraudulent trades were confirmed. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN): Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. FinCEN disclosed it is investigating a cybersecurity incident resulting in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems. Some systems were taken offline as a precaution. Washington, United States.

incidents.title: Todoist / Doist: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Todoist disclosed that an attacker used stolen credentials to download account records for about 6% of users, including emails and salted password hashes. The notice was published on November 24. San Francisco, United States.

incidents.title: Central Intelligence Agency (CIA): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. The CIA confirmed a cybersecurity breach that exposed some of its unclassified information. The intrusion affected an open-source intelligence analysis system, with no classified information reportedly compromised. McLean, United States.

incidents.victim: Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI)
incidents.title: Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. The ODNI confirmed that a shared unclassified system for analyzing publicly available information was compromised. It stated there were no disruptions to critical capabilities or classified systems. McLean, United States.

incidents.title: Keio: Confirmed ransomware attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Keio Corporation announced that a ransomware attack detected in September may have leaked personal information on up to 11.08 million people, including copies of identity documents and credit card numbers. Roughly 12,300 customers and job applicants were confirmed in a separate disclosure the same day. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: PayU: Confirmed extortion attempt
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Criminals exploited PayU's payout API to conduct fraud. Two individuals were arrested in connection with the financial crime. India.

incidents.title: Deichmann SE: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Deichmann reported unauthorized access to selected customer data from its online shop, potentially including names, addresses, and invoices, but not passwords or card numbers. Essen, Germany.

incidents.title: Snipes (SNIPES SAS): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Unauthorized access to purchase-related customer data via an exploited flaw now fixed. The company updated an information page but did not disclose the number of affected clients. France.

incidents.title: Maileva / La Poste: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. A breach at La Poste's digital mail subsidiary exposed data belonging to 22 million individuals. The incident was highlighted as one of the largest data losses of the week. France.

incidents.title: London Gatwick Airport: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Unauthorized access to a third-party drop-off payment system exposed contact and vehicle information. Partial payment-card details were accessed in isolated cases. Crawley, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: Check Point: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Management servers at 22 organisations were compromised. The cybersecurity vendor's infrastructure was targeted in the incident. Tel Aviv, Israel.

incidents.title: Allied Media / Allied Press: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. New Zealand newspaper publisher Allied Media / Allied Press reported on 24 November 2026 that production systems were disrupted and distribution of several regional newspapers was delayed. No attacker was identified. Dunedin, New Zealand.

incidents.title: Teachers On Reserve: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Teachers On Reserve reported a breach of customer personal information to the California Attorney General. The incident itself occurred on October 20, 2026. United States.

incidents.title: Quirónsalud: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Quirónsalud reported an attack that stole email addresses from its databases, reaching Madrid public-health patients, while denying exposure of clinical records. Madrid, Spain.

incidents.title: JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. JAXA reported on 24 November 2026 that its public Earth-observation data system had been accessed without authorisation on 18 November. Account information for roughly 2,000 users was exposed. Chōfu, Japan.

incidents.title: TENTIAL: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. TENTIAL reported a breach via the KARTE marketing platform affecting 124,348 people after deduplication, including customer identification numbers and contact details. Japan.

incidents.title: Weleda Japan: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Weleda Japan reported a breach of its official online shop potentially exposing 198,792 personal-information records and 45,689 card records. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Pet Medical Support: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Pet Medical Support reported a third-party server breach potentially affecting up to approximately 210,000 customers who had requested information materials. Japan.

incidents.title: PLANT: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. PLANT reported a contractor server breach exposing 42,107 records including card numbers, PINs, and email addresses associated with its electronic money payment service. Japan.

incidents.title: Fuji United Holdings / Fuji Kosan: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Fuji United Holdings reported unauthorized access with partial data leakage confirmed, leading to the suspension of web orders. Japan.

incidents.title: Infonet Group: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Infonet Group reported unauthorized access to a shared infoCMS server, resulting in the temporary suspension of customer sites pending investigation. Japan.

incidents.title: Nulab: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Nulab reported a breach affecting its Cacoo collaborative whiteboard service. The service resumed on November 24, but the video-call feature remained suspended. Minato, Japan.

incidents.title: giftee: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. giftee reported a contractor (prismatix) breach. Its consumer service resumed on November 24, though the extent of logged data acquisition is still being verified. Japan.

incidents.title: MTG: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. MTG reported a GoQSystem breach and corrected the affected count to 17,605. Unauthorized access occurred on November 10-11. Japan.

incidents.title: Kids Well Bio: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Kids Well Bio reported unauthorized access to its group websites via a website-operations contractor. Japan.

incidents.title: CS Marketing: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. CS Marketing reported a site breach affecting 3,633 people, with card numbers, security codes, names, and expiry dates at risk. Japan.

incidents.title: Banco do Brasil: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Banco do Brasil told some account holders that third parties had improper access to personal data in November, including name, CPF, email, branch number and in some cases account number. No intrusion of internal systems occurred. Brasília, Brazil.

incidents.title: CIA: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. An unclassified CIA system was breached in a cyberattack affecting an open-source intelligence analysis platform. The breach did not involve classified information and the issue has been resolved. United States.

incidents.title: ODNI: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. The Office of the Director of National Intelligence was named alongside the CIA as affected in the same intrusion. ODNI stated there was no impact to critical functions or classified systems. Washington, United States.

incidents.title: FinCEN: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. FinCEN took systems offline after unauthorized access, disrupting financial-regulatory filing services and creating a backlog. Official cyber disclosure was made on November 24. Washington, United States.

incidents.title: KodeKloud: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. KodeKloud disclosed that an intruder entered an internal reporting tool on November 10 by exploiting a software vulnerability, exposing names, emails, usernames, marketing preferences, last-login times and job titles. No passwords or card details were reached. India.
